content.comment_body: Hello everyone. From what I’ve seen, it doesn’t seem possible to fully lock the keys on the [product_name]. While the password option is available, it only restricts specific actions. I noticed it's still possible to change the date and time, which could then be used within the program.

analysis.insight_summary: The user points out that password protection on the [product_name] only restricts certain functions, while changes to date and time remain possible and could impact the program. This limited protection may pose a security risk or might allow unintended changes, indicating a gap between expected and actual security controls.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is seeking a solution that would enforce password protection on all aspects of the device, including date and time settings, to prevent unauthorized changes and improve overall security by locking all keys.
